lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Reteach and varied practice: assumptions and constraints

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $80 rate will increase by 25%. What is the new rate?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

items.prompt: A storage container is 4 by 3 by 2 feet. What is its volume in cubic feet?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 27, 32, 37, 42, 47. The mean is 37. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 3 by 7 units has a volume of 14 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 84 cubic units, not 14.
No; the volume is 15 cubic units, not 14.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
Yes; the volume is 14 cubic units.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $6 base fee plus $5 per hour. A customer's total bill was $36. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 16 m, then descends another 15 m, then ascends 17 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 46 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $680 rate will decrease by 20%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 2 ft long, 10 ft wide, and 8 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 34, 39, 44, 49, 54. The mean is 44. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 2 by 8 by 7 units has a volume of 119 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 121 cubic units, not 119.
Yes; the volume is 119 cubic units.
No; the volume is 112 cubic units, not 119.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $10 base fee plus $4 per hour. A customer's total bill was $26. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?
